# vergeio_tenant_snapshot (Resource)

Keeps one snapshot of a tenant. Create takes the snapshot. `description` updates in place. `expires` and `never_expires` update the expiration in place. Set `expires` to a Unix timestamp, or set `never_expires` to true, and only one of them. `never_expires` defaults to false, so a snapshot with no expiration argument needs `expires`.

`name` can be set when the snapshot is created. Omit it and VergeOS assigns one, and Terraform stores that name. VergeOS does not rename a snapshot, and the update call has no name field. A computed-only name would ignore a rename in configuration, so a new name replaces the snapshot: Terraform deletes the old row and creates the new one. `type` works the same way. It is the coverage, `full`, `partial_include`, or `partial_exclude`. Omit it and VergeOS uses `full`. Changing it replaces the snapshot. `tenant_id` replaces the snapshot too, because a snapshot cannot move to another tenant.

This is a different block from the [`vergeio_tenant_snapshot` action](../actions/tenant_snapshot.html). The action takes a snapshot from `terraform apply -invoke` or an `action_trigger` and does not keep it in state. Use the action for a one-off recovery point before a change. Use this resource when Terraform should retain the snapshot and update its description or expiration.

`type` is not the Provider or Local label from the tenant cloud snapshot screen. That label belongs to cloud snapshots. This resource stores the coverage on the tenant snapshot row.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep a snapshot of a tenant. name can be omitted and VergeOS will assign one.
# Changing name, tenant_id, or type replaces the snapshot. description and the
# expiration update in place. The vergeio_tenant_snapshot action takes a
# snapshot and does not keep it in state.

resource "vergeio_tenant_snapshot" "example" {
  tenant_id   = vergeio_tenant.example.id
  name        = "before-change"
  description = "Taken before the maintenance window"
  type        = "full"
  expires     = 1893456000
}

resource "vergeio_tenant_snapshot" "keep" {
  tenant_id     = vergeio_tenant.example.id
  name          = "keep"
  description   = "Kept until it is deleted"
  never_expires = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) Key of the parent `vergeio_tenant`. Changing it replaces the snapshot.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Snapshot description. Omit it to leave the current description unchanged. Set it, including to an empty string, to change it.
- `expires` (Number) Unix timestamp when the snapshot expires. Set this or `never_expires`, and only one of them.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name. Omit it and VergeOS assigns one. Changing it replaces the snapshot.
- `never_expires` (Boolean) When true, the snapshot does not expire. Set this or `expires`. Defaults to false, which requires `expires`.
- `type` (String) Snapshot coverage: `full`, `partial_include`, or `partial_exclude`. Omit it and VergeOS uses `full`. Changing it replaces the snapshot.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) Snapshot key assigned by VergeOS.

## Import

Import with the snapshot key, or with the tenant key and the snapshot name separated by a slash.

```shell
terraform import vergeio_tenant_snapshot.example 15
terraform import vergeio_tenant_snapshot.example 7/before-change
```
